example.title: Gastropub on a corner with a painted brick front (Father's Office)
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1970s single-storey corner bar: a narrow painted-brick front with a timber door and small windows, a vintage projecting neon sign, a black-and-white striped neighbour and a big old sign pole on the roof. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
